attach-zugferd-xml-to-pdf.title: Attach ZUGFeRD XML to PDF and Convert to PDF/A‑3B
attach-zugferd-xml-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates embedding a ZUGFeRD invoice XML file into a PDF as an embedded file, setting the AFRelationship, converting the PDF to PDF/A‑3B compliance, and saving the result.

validate-pdf-zugferd-compliance.title: Validate ZUGFeRD PDF against PDF/A‑3U using Aspose.Pdf
validate-pdf-zugferd-compliance.description: Shows how to load a PDF file and use Aspose.Pdf to validate that it conforms to the ZUGFeRD (PDF/A‑3) specification, producing an XML validation report.

extract-zugferd-xml-from-pdf.title: Extract ZUGFeRD XML from PDF
extract-zugferd-xml-from-pdf.description: Shows how to locate the embedded ZUGFeRD XML attachment inside a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and save it to a local file.

update-zugferd-xml-attachment.title: Update ZUGFeRD XML Attachment in PDF
update-zugferd-xml-attachment.description: Shows how to replace or add a ZUGFeRD XML file embedded in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf by deleting any existing attachment and inserting the new XML content.

remove-zugferd-attachment-from-pdf.title: Remove ZUGFeRD Attachment from PDF
remove-zugferd-attachment-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, find embedded files whose name or description contains "ZUGFeRD", delete those attachments, and save the resulting document.

add-custom-metadata-to-zugferd-pdf.title: Add Custom Metadata to ZUGFeRD PDF
add-custom-metadata-to-zugferd-pdf.description: Shows how to load an existing ZUGFeRD PDF, add custom metadata entries such as ProjectCode and Department, update the modification date, and save the file while preserving the ZUGFeRD attachment.

encrypt-zugferd-pdf-with-passwords.title: Encrypt ZUGFeRD PDF with User and Owner Passwords
encrypt-zugferd-pdf-with-passwords.description: Demonstrates loading a ZUGFeRD PDF, applying AES‑256 encryption with both user and owner passwords, setting specific permissions, and saving the encrypted document.

digitally-sign-zugferd-pdf-with-timestam.title: Digitally Sign PDF with PKCS#7 and Timestamp
digitally-sign-zugferd-pdf-with-timestam.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a visible signature field, applying a PKCS#7 digital signature from a PFX certificate, and attaching a timestamp from a TSA server, then saving the signed document.

add-expiry-javascript-action-to-pdf.title: Add Expiry JavaScript Action to PDF
add-expiry-javascript-action-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a document‑level JavaScript OpenAction that checks an expiry date and closes the PDF if the date has passed.

set-pdf-open-action-navigate-page-10.title: Add JavaScript Open Action to Navigate to Page 10
set-pdf-open-action-navigate-page-10.description: Creates a PDF, adds a blank page, and sets an open‑action JavaScript that jumps to page 10 (zero‑based index 9) when the document is opened.

add-page-level-javascript-alert-to-pdf.title: Add Page-Level JavaScript Alert to PDF
add-page-level-javascript-alert-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a page‑level JavaScript action that displays an alert when the user navigates to a specific page using Aspose.Pdf.

calculate-total-order-amount.title: Add JavaScript Calculation to PDF Form Total Field
calculate-total-order-amount.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF form, retrieving a TextBoxField, attaching a JavaScript Calculate action that sums Qty×Price line‑items, and saving the updated PDF.

add-auto-save-javascript-to-pdf.title: Add Auto‑Save JavaScript to PDF
add-auto-save-javascript-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a document‑level JavaScript action that automatically saves the PDF at defined intervals using Aspose.Pdf.

draw-star-shape-low-level-operators.title: Draw a Star Shape on a PDF Page Using Low‑Level Operators
draw-star-shape-low-level-operators.description: Demonstrates how to insert low‑level PDF graphics operators to draw and fill a custom star shape at a specified position on an existing PDF page.

change-pdf-line-width.title: Change PDF Line Width from 1pt to 3pt
change-pdf-line-width.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through each page's content operators, locate SetLineWidth operators and set their width to 3 points, then save the updated document.

remove-background-operators-from-pdf.title: Remove Background Operators from PDF Content Stream
remove-background-operators-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, iterates each page's content stream, and deletes drawing operators (Do and BI) that create unwanted background graphics before saving the cleaned document.

replace-text-using-showtext-operators.title: Replace Text in PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
replace-text-using-showtext-operators.description: Demonstrates how to locate text‑show operators in a PDF and replace a specific string with a new one using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragmentAbsorber.

create-line-graph-multiple-stroke-styles.title: Create Line Graph with Distinct Stroke Styles in PDF
create-line-graph-multiple-stroke-styles.description: Shows how to generate a PDF line chart with three data series, each rendered with a different stroke style (solid, dashed, dotted) using Aspose.Pdf.

embed-vector-graphic-graph-into-pdf.title: Embed Vector Graphic into PDF Page
embed-vector-graphic-graph-into-pdf.description: Shows how to create a Graph object with line shapes and embed it directly into a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

combine-multiple-graphs-on-single-pdf-pa.title: Combine Four Graph Images into a 2x2 Grid PDF
combine-multiple-graphs-on-single-pdf-pa.description: Shows how to place four image files onto a single PDF page arranged in a 2‑by‑2 grid using Aspose.Pdf.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add File Attachment Annotation to PDF
add-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a PDF file as a file‑attachment annotation in another PDF, including setting a description and MIME type.

attach-multiple-files-to-pdf.title: Attach Multiple Files with Descriptions to a PDF
attach-multiple-files-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed several files into a PDF, assign custom descriptions, and optionally add visible attachment annotations using Aspose.Pdf.

list-pdf-attachments-names-sizes.title: List PDF Attachments and Their Sizes
list-pdf-attachments-names-sizes.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, enumerate its embedded files, and output each attachment's name and byte size.

remove-specific-attachment-from-pdf.title: Remove Specific Attachment from PDF by Filename
remove-specific-attachment-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to delete a particular embedded file from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while preserving other attachments.

update-pdf-attachment-description.title: Update PDF Attachment Description
update-pdf-attachment-description.description: Shows how to locate an embedded file in a PDF, change its description property, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-metadata-and-custom-property.title: Set PDF Metadata and Custom Invoice Property
set-pdf-metadata-and-custom-property.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set standard metadata fields such as Title and Author, add a custom property for the invoice number, and save the updated document.

read-custom-pdf-metadata-log.title: Read Custom PDF Metadata and Write Audit Log
read-custom-pdf-metadata-log.description: The example opens a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extracts both standard and custom document metadata, and writes the information to a log file for auditing purposes.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-with-passwords.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Passwords
encrypt-pdf-aes256-with-passwords.description: Demonstrates how to apply AES‑256 encryption to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, specifying separate user and owner passwords and setting basic permissions.

set-pdf-permissions-allow-printing.title: Set PDF Permissions for Printing Only
set-pdf-permissions-allow-printing.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, allowing only printing while disabling content copying and annotation modifications.

convert-pdf-to-docx-preserve-layout.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Layout Preservation
convert-pdf-to-docx-preserve-layout.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and save it as a DOCX file while preserving the original layout, fonts, and tables by using the EnhancedFlow recognition mode.

convert-pdf-to-html-with-embedded-images.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Embedded Base64 Images
convert-pdf-to-html-with-embedded-images.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to a single HTML document using Aspose.Pdf, embedding all images as Base64 data URIs.

convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-png.title: Convert PDF Page to High-Resolution PNG
convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-png.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, selecting a specific page, and rendering it to a PNG image at 300 DPI using the PngDevice.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-jpeg.title: Batch Convert PDFs to JPEG Images
batch-convert-pdfs-to-jpeg.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through all PDF files in a folder, convert each page to a high‑resolution JPEG image using Aspose.Pdf, and name the output files after the source PDF.

export-selected-pdf-pages.title: Extract Selected PDF Pages to Separate Files
export-selected-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to extract specific pages from a PDF and save each as an individual PDF file while preserving the original page size and orientation.

extract-text-from-pdf-with-line-breaks.title: Extract Text from PDF with Layout Preservation
extract-text-from-pdf-with-line-breaks.description: Demonstrates how to extract all textual content from a PDF while retaining line breaks and spacing using Aspose.Pdf's TextAbsorber with Pure formatting mode.

populate-pdf-form-from-json-and-flatten.title: Populate PDF Form Fields from JSON and Flatten
populate-pdf-form-from-json-and-flatten.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF form, filling its fields with values from a JSON file, flattening the form to make it read‑only, and saving the result.

print-pdf-silently-to-default-printer.title: Print PDF to Default Printer Silently
print-pdf-silently-to-default-printer.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and send it to the default printer using the OS "print" verb, avoiding any print dialog.

print-pdf-range-to-network-printer.title: Print PDF Page Range to Network Printer with Duplex and A4
print-pdf-range-to-network-printer.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, converts a specified page range to PNG images, and sends them to a network printer with duplex mode and A4 paper size configured.

add-javascript-open-action-jump-to-page-.title: Add JavaScript Open Action to Jump to Page 5
add-javascript-open-action-jump-to-page-.description: Demonstrates how to attach a JavaScript open action to a PDF that automatically navigates to page five when the document is opened, using Aspose.Pdf.

add-auto-print-javascript-action-to-pdf.title: Add Auto‑Print JavaScript to PDF
add-auto-print-javascript-action-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a JavaScript action in a PDF that automatically opens the print dialog when the document is opened, using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-author-dynamically.title: Set PDF Author to Current System User
set-pdf-author-dynamically.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, retrieving the current OS user name, setting the Author metadata property, and saving the updated document.

hide-form-field-with-checkbox.title: Toggle PDF Form Field Visibility with Checkbox JavaScript
hide-form-field-with-checkbox.description: Shows how to attach JavaScript to a checkbox in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf so that another form field is hidden or shown based on the checkbox state.

embed-qr-code-image-at-specific-coordina.title: Embed QR Code in PDF using Aspose.Pdf
embed-qr-code-image-at-specific-coordina.description: The example opens an existing PDF, creates a TextBox form field at specified coordinates, generates a QR code from a URL, and saves the modified document.

compress-pdf-images-optimization.title: Compress PDF Using Image Optimization Options
compress-pdf-images-optimization.description: Demonstrates how to reduce a PDF file size by applying image compression, down‑sampling, and cleanup options using Aspose.Pdf's optimization API.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa-2b.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A‑2b for Archival Compliance
convert-pdf-to-pdfa-2b.description: Loads an existing PDF, converts it to PDF/A‑2b compliance using Aspose.Pdf, and saves the resulting file for long‑term archival.

add-xmp-metadata-pdfa-compliance.title: Add PDF/A XMP Metadata to a PDF
add-xmp-metadata-pdfa-compliance.description: Shows how to embed required PDF/A XMP metadata such as document ID, creator tool, and timestamps into an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdfa3b-after-adding-zugferd-att.title: Add ZUGFeRD XML Attachment and Validate PDF/A‑3U Compliance
validate-pdfa3b-after-adding-zugferd-att.description: Demonstrates embedding a ZUGFeRD XML file into a PDF, converting the document to PDF/A‑3U, and checking the resulting file for PDF/A compliance using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-zugferd-to-pdfa3u.title: Convert PDF with ZUGFeRD attachment to PDF/A-3u
convert-pdf-zugferd-to-pdfa3u.description: Shows how to load a PDF containing a ZUGFeRD XML attachment, convert it to PDF/A‑3u while preserving the embedded XML, and save the resulting file.

extract-validate-zugferd-xml.title: Extract and Validate ZUGFeRD XML from PDF
extract-validate-zugferd-xml.description: Demonstrates how to locate the ZUGFeRD XML attachment inside a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, extract it to a stream, and validate the XML against the official ZUGFeRD XSD schema.

batch-generate-zugferd-pdfs-from-csv.title: Batch Generate ZUGFeRD PDF Invoices from CSV
batch-generate-zugferd-pdfs-from-csv.description: Shows how to read invoice data from a CSV file, create PDF/A‑3B invoices with Aspose.Pdf, embed the corresponding ZUGFeRD XML, and save each PDF in a batch process.

embed-custom-ttf-font-in-pdf-graph.title: Embed Custom TrueType Font in PDF Graph
embed-custom-ttf-font-in-pdf-graph.description: Demonstrates registering a custom TrueType font and embedding it in a PDF that contains a graph, ensuring titles and legends render correctly on all devices.

subset-custom-font-in-pdf.title: Embed Subset of a Custom Font in PDF
subset-custom-font-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a TrueType/OpenType font, enabling subset embedding, and using it to render text in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, thereby reducing the PDF file size.

hide-toolbar-menu-bar-pdf-javascript.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences via JavaScript (Hide Toolbar & Menu Bar)
hide-toolbar-menu-bar-pdf-javascript.description: Demonstrates how to assign a JavaScript OpenAction to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf so that the toolbar and menu bar are hidden when the document opens.

create-pdf-page-transitions-javascript.title: Create PDF with Page Transition Effects via JavaScript
create-pdf-page-transitions-javascript.description: Shows how to add different page transition styles and durations to each PDF page by attaching a JavaScript action that calls this.setPageTransition.

add-javascript-calculation-to-pdf-total.title: Add JavaScript Calculation to PDF Form Total Field
add-javascript-calculation-to-pdf-total.description: Demonstrates how to attach a JavaScript calculate action to a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf, summing line‑item fields and displaying the total in a textbox field.

secure-pdf-form-filling-only.title: Secure PDF for Form Filling Only
secure-pdf-form-filling-only.description: Shows how to apply security settings to a PDF so that only form filling is permitted while editing, printing, and content extraction are blocked, using Aspose.Pdf encryption.

list-javascript-actions-in-pdf.title: List JavaScript Actions in PDF (Document and Page Level)
list-javascript-actions-in-pdf.description: Shows how to extract document‑level and page‑level JavaScript actions from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf for auditing purposes.

extract-pdf-text-to-searchable-index.title: Batch Extract Text from PDFs and Create a Searchable JSON Index
extract-pdf-text-to-searchable-index.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over a folder of PDF files, extract all text using Aspose.Pdf's TextAbsorber, and store the results in a JSON‑based searchable index.

add-encrypted-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Encrypt PDF and Add Encrypted Attachment
add-encrypted-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a file into a PDF and encrypt the whole document (including the attachment) with user and owner passwords using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-creation-modification-dates.title: Set PDF Creation and Modification Dates
set-pdf-creation-modification-dates.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically set the creation and modification timestamps of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf. The example loads an existing PDF, updates its metadata, and saves the result.

render-pdf-page-to-png-high-quality-anti.title: Render PDF Pages to High-Resolution PNG with Anti-Aliasing
render-pdf-page-to-png-high-quality-anti.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, set a high DPI resolution, and export each page as a PNG image, taking advantage of the renderer's built-in anti-aliasing for smoother graphics.

add-password-prompt-javascript-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript Password Prompt to PDF
add-password-prompt-javascript-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed JavaScript in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf to request a password when the document is opened and close the file if the password is incorrect.

add-signature-field-with-js-validation.title: Add a Digital Signature Field to a PDF
add-signature-field-with-js-validation.description: Shows how to create a PDF document, add a page, and place a digital signature field using Aspose.Pdf.

import-fdf-data-into-pdf-and-flatten-for.title: Import FDF Data into PDF and Flatten Form
import-fdf-data-into-pdf-and-flatten-for.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, parsing a simple FDF file to populate matching form fields, flattening the form to make it read‑only, and saving the updated document.

set-pdf-document-language.title: Set PDF Language Property for Accessibility
set-pdf-document-language.description: Demonstrates how to set the primary language of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API, improving screen‑reader accessibility, and then save the updated file.

add-javascript-toggle-optional-sections.title: Add JavaScript to Toggle PDF Form Section Visibility
add-javascript-toggle-optional-sections.description: Demonstrates creating a combo box and optional text fields in a PDF, setting their initial hidden state, and embedding JavaScript that shows or hides the fields based on the user's selection using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-table-of-contents-with-outlin.title: Create PDF Table of Contents with Clickable Links and Bookmarks
create-pdf-table-of-contents-with-outlin.description: Loads an existing PDF, identifies heading fragments by font size, and generates a TOC page that includes clickable link annotations and outline bookmarks pointing to each heading.

batch-apply-pdf-password-protection.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with Password Protection
batch-apply-pdf-password-protection.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt all PDF files in a folder using Aspose.Pdf by applying the same user and owner passwords and setting basic permissions.

dynamic-header-footer-pdf.title: Create PDF with Dynamic Header and Footer using JavaScript
dynamic-header-footer-pdf.description: Shows how to add header and footer text fields to each page and attach JavaScript that updates them with the current page number and total pages when the page opens.

add-auto-close-javascript-to-pdf.title: Add Auto-Close JavaScript to PDF
add-auto-close-javascript-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates embedding JavaScript in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf to automatically close the document after a specified timeout.

create-multi-column-text-layout.title: Create Multi-Column Text Layout in PDF
create-multi-column-text-layout.description: Shows how to programmatically flow a long text into multiple columns on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf by calculating column dimensions, performing simple word‑wrapping, and placing TextFragment objects.

create-pdf-invoice-with-embedded-zugferd.title: Create PDF Invoice with Embedded ZUGFeRD XML (PDF/A‑3)
create-pdf-invoice-with-embedded-zugferd.description: The example shows how to generate a minimal ZUGFeRD XML document from an order, embed it into a PDF as an attached file, convert the PDF to PDF/A‑3U compliance, and save the final invoice.

layered-transparent-rectangles-pdf.title: Create Layered Transparent Ellipses in PDF
layered-transparent-rectangles-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf Graph and Ellipse objects with alpha‑channel colors to draw overlapping semi‑transparent shapes and save the result as a PDF.

create-bar-chart-pdf.title: Create Bar Chart PDF with Custom Colors and Labels
create-bar-chart-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF containing a bar chart using Aspose.Pdf's Graph API, including custom bar colors, axis drawing, and axis labels.

digitally-sign-pdf-with-pfx-timestamp.title: Digitally Sign PDF with PFX Certificate and Timestamp
digitally-sign-pdf-with-pfx-timestamp.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, add a visible signature field, configure a PKCS#7 signature using a PFX certificate, apply a timestamp server, and save the signed document using Aspose.Pdf.

verify-pdf-digital-signature.title: Verify PDF Digital Signature Using Aspose.Pdf Facade
verify-pdf-digital-signature.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically verify digital signatures in a PDF and extract signer details by invoking Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSignature via reflection.

merge-pdfs-with-bookmarks__v2.title: Merge PDFs While Preserving Bookmarks
merge-pdfs-with-bookmarks__v2.description: Combines multiple PDF files into a single document and copies the source outlines (bookmarks) preserving their hierarchy using Aspose.Pdf.

split-pdf-into-individual-pages__v2.title: Split PDF into Single-Page PDFs
split-pdf-into-individual-pages__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over its pages, and save each page as an individual PDF file.

extract-images-from-pdf__v2.title: Extract Images from PDF with Original Format
extract-images-from-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through PDF pages, retrieve embedded XImage objects, and save each image in its original format and resolution using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v4.title: Extract PDF Form Fields to JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v4.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates through all form fields, reads each field's value according to its type, and outputs the collected data as a formatted JSON object.

add-semi-transparent-text-watermark__v3.title: Add Semi-Transparent Watermark Behind PDF Content
add-semi-transparent-text-watermark__v3.description: Demonstrates how to place a semi‑transparent text watermark behind the existing content on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-javascript-from-pdf__v2.title: Remove JavaScript from PDF Document
remove-javascript-from-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to strip document‑level and annotation‑level JavaScript actions from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf to improve security.

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff__v3.title: Convert PDF to Multi‑Page TIFF
convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff__v3.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configure TIFF settings, and export all pages as a single multi‑page TIFF file using LZW compression at 300 DPI.

generate-png-thumbnails-for-pdf-pages__v.title: Generate PNG Thumbnails for PDF Pages
generate-png-thumbnails-for-pdf-pages__v.description: Loads a PDF document, creates a PNG device with a defined resolution, and renders each page to an individual PNG thumbnail saved in a designated folder.

draw-pie-chart-using-low-level-operators.title: Draw Pie Chart with Low‑Level PDF Operators
draw-pie-chart-using-low-level-operators.description: Shows how to generate a simple pie chart in a PDF by using Aspose.Pdf low‑level graphics operators to draw colored slices based on sales percentages.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v2.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and save only its annotations to an XFDF (FDF) file for external processing or archiving.
